title: Made-up: located factors, before and after
about: The shape of the first step sentier-bafu will show: a flow that names a country takes that country's factor. Six made-up datasets, four indicators. The claim names the indicators whose factors are taken by country; sentier-bafu builds that list from its build.

steps.label: Located factors
steps.about: A flow that names a country takes that country's factor instead of the world's.

claim.text: Water use and land use may move; nothing else moves.
